description.p: RustyBird is a proxy and VPN client for Linux phones and GNOME desktops. It drives the sing-box core and covers every outbound it ships: VLESS, VMess, Trojan, Shadowsocks, Hysteria, Hysteria 2, TUIC, AnyTLS, ShadowTLS, Snell, SSH, Tor, HTTP, SOCKS and WireGuard endpoints.

Transports, multiplexing, UDP over TCP, REALITY, uTLS and encrypted client hello are all editable per node. Routing exposes the full sing-box rule surface with local and remote rule sets, and DNS accepts plain, DoT, DoH, DoQ, HTTP/3, DHCP and FakeIP resolvers.
Import nodes from subscriptions and Clash configurations, or hand a complete sing-box JSON profile to the core and let it drive every routing decision.
